label: Сестра
description: Twelve-mission case drill for сестра (sister) — all six cases, singular and plural.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative singular. The dictionary form сестра is the subject of живёт. First-declension feminine nouns in -а keep this bare ending in the nominative singular, naming who performs the action.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular. The possessive construction у plus genitive turns сестра into сестры. Hard feminines take the genitive singular ending -ы.
Strategic focus: Dative singular. The verb звонить governs the dative recipient, so сестра becomes сестре. The dative singular ending for first-declension feminines is -е.

Strategic focus: Accusative singular. The direct object of видел takes the accusative сестру, where nominative -а becomes -у. In the singular even animate feminines use this dedicated -у form, distinct from the genitive.
Strategic focus: Instrumental singular. The verb гордиться governs the instrumental, so сестра appears as сестрой. The instrumental singular ending for hard feminines is -ой.
Strategic focus: Prepositional singular. After о meaning about, сестра takes the prepositional сестре. The prepositional singular ending -е matches the dative for first-declension feminines.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. The plural subject is сёстры, an irregular form: a fleeting ё appears in the stem, and the ending shifts to -ы. The nominative plural of сестра is сёстры.

Strategic focus: Genitive plural. The genitive plural is the irregular сестёр, with an inserted fleeting vowel ё between the consonants and a zero ending. The negation нет plus genitive triggers it here.

Strategic focus: Dative plural. The dative plural ending -ам attaches to the ё-stem to give сёстрам, the recipients of the letters. The fleeting ё of the plural stem stays where it is not at the very end.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural. Because сестра is animate, the accusative plural equals the genitive plural сестёр rather than the nominative. The direct object of люблю therefore takes the form сестёр.

Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. After с meaning together with, the instrumental plural ending -ами produces сёстрами from the ё-stem. The -ами ending is regular even on this irregular plural stem.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. The prepositional plural ending -ах attaches to the ё-stem to give сёстрах. This ending is constant for hard feminines in the prepositional plural.
